deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description:
The plugin description. Max length is 2000 characters (Unicode code
points).
description.rationale: Human-readable description only. No security impact.

display_name.description:
The display name of the plugin. Max length is 50 characters (Unicode code
points).

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

plugin_id.description:
The ID to use for the Plugin resource, which will become the final
component of the Plugin's resource name. This field is optional.

* If provided, the same will be used. The service will throw an error if
the specified id is already used by another Plugin resource in the API hub
instance.
* If not provided, a system generated id will be used.

This value should be 4-63 characters, overall resource name which will be
of format
'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/plugins/{plugin}',
its length is limited to 1000 characters and valid characters are
/a-z[0-9]-_/.
plugin_id.rationale: Acts as identifier. No inherent security risk.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

actions_config.description: The configuration of actions supported by the plugin.

actions_config.description.description: The description of the operation performed by the action.

actions_config.display_name.description: The display name of the action.

actions_config.trigger_mode.description:
The trigger mode supported by the action.
Possible values:
TRIGGER_MODE_UNSPECIFIED
API_HUB_ON_DEMAND_TRIGGER
API_HUB_SCHEDULE_TRIGGER
NON_API_HUB_MANAGED

config_template.description: ConfigTemplate represents the configuration template for a plugin.

config_template.additional_config_templa.description:
The list of additional configuration variables for the plugin's
configuration.
ID of the config variable. Must be unique within the configuration.

Flag represents that this 'ConfigVariable' must be provided for a
PluginInstance.

Regular expression in RE2 syntax used for validating the 'value' of a
'ConfigVariable'.

Type of the parameter: string, int, bool etc.
Possible values:
VALUE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED
STRING
INT
BOOL
SECRET
ENUM
MULTI_SELECT
MULTI_STRING
MULTI_INT
config_template.additional_config_templa.rationale: Indicates type of value. Not sensitive itself.

config_template.additional_config_templa.description: Enum options. To be populated if 'ValueType' is 'ENUM'.
Multi select options. To be populated if 'ValueType' is 'MULTI_SELECT'.

config_template.auth_config_template.description: AuthConfigTemplate represents the authentication template for a plugin.

config_template.auth_config_template.sup.description: The list of authentication types supported by the plugin.
config_template.auth_config_template.sup.rationale: Declares which auth types the plugin template supports. This is a descriptive capability list on a template (not the chosen auth method), so constraining it would not enforce a secure auth choice; the enforceable control is the selected auth_type on the instance.

config_template.auth_config_template.ser.description: Config for Google service account authentication.

The service account to be used for authenticating request.

The 'iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken' permission should be granted on
this service account to the impersonator service account.
config_template.auth_config_template.ser.rationale: References the service account used by the auth config template. This is a pointer to an existing identity resource chosen by the team; we do not constrain which specific service account is referenced, and a generic policy could not name one.

documentation.external_uri.description: The uri of the externally hosted documentation.
documentation.external_uri.rationale: Points to external docs. No secret values.

hosting_service.description:
The information related to the service implemented by the plugin
developer, used to invoke the plugin's functionality.

hosting_service.service_uri.description:
The URI of the service implemented by the plugin developer, used to
invoke the plugin's functionality. This information is only required for
user defined plugins.
